Package com.nexuslink.core.env

package com.nexuslink.core.env
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Environment
    A named set of variables the user can switch between — typically dev / staging / prod.
    EnvironmentService
    Owns the user's named environments (dev / staging / prod, …), the currently active one, and an optional .env file, and resolves ${VAR} references against them.
    EnvironmentService.Data
    On-disk shape: the saved environments + the id of the active one.
    EnvVariable
    A single named variable inside an Environment.
    SecretMaskingFilter
    Keeps secret values from leaking into logs and the UI.
    VariableInterpolator
    Substitutes ${VAR} placeholders in any string field using a pluggable resolver (normally EnvironmentService).

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
